market.summary_html: The Maps leaderboard is reshuffling. Across the same 11-month window we've been tracking, the prior leaders are losing ground — Glam Shots down 283 top-3 cells, VIP Party Photo Booth down 381 — while three brands rose from near-zero: Captured Fun (+358), Luxe Booth (+319), Capture Pod (+274). That's a moment of category-flux. Brands with strong foundations who align their GBP correctly can move up the leaderboard fast — that's the exact opportunity the 90-day plan below targets.

focus_months.summary: Two GBP-level changes inside the first week clear the ceiling that's been blocking the foundation from translating into rank. Mid-month, the URL structure consolidates from 27 random-adjective slugs into 15 clean /photo-booth-rental/[city]/ pages — the architecture the dominant brands' wins are quietly built on. We also wire the existing blog winners (photo-strip-size posts driving 1,556 clicks/90d) to the booth-type service pages with in-body links + CTAs.
focus_months.by_end_of_month: Foundations align. First LD scan post-category-change shows the first signal of upward movement on the Photo Booth queries that were previously zero. Blog traffic begins funneling to commercial pages instead of dead-ending.

tldr: The Maps gap is structural, not effort. MIA's Google Business profile primary category is Photography service; five of the eight top-3 dominators citywide run Photo booth as primary (Glam Shots wins 419 top-3 cells with only 15 reviews — the category match is doing the lifting). On top of that, the site footer phone is (786) 973-9973 — the GBP's chat/SMS number — while the GBP primary phone is (786) 833-7645; that NAP mismatch suppresses the site→GBP trust signal. Fix those two and the foundation (124 backlinks · 103 reviews · 739-cell average reach · organic clicks 26 → 768 in 5 months = a 30× HQDM-tenure climb) is positioned to convert.

headline.h2: Root cause is two GBP-level fixes — not site depth
headline.lede: Across 11 months of LD scans (Aug 5 2025 → May 6 2026), MIA's average rank sits at 10.69 on the latest scan (weighted across 8 tracked queries) with 43 top-3 cells out of 663 cells reached. Organic clicks have grown 30× — from 26/mo at engagement start to a peak of 768 in Jan '26. The two highest-intent Maps terms ("wedding photo booth rental" and "360 photo booth rental") show zero top-3 cells in the latest scan, and the tracked queries are still mostly outside the local pack — the gap is where the GBP-category fix targets.

connection.intro: Five elements of the website↔GBP handshake. The site is built — 27 area pages, 6 service pages, 60 blog posts — but the bones aren't connected. The most consequential break is the phone number; the rest compound it.
connection.verdict: The website doesn't currently reinforce the GBP. Until the phone number, schema and URL structure match, every link Google follows from the GBP into the site reads as a weak association.

rows.detail: The GBP primary phone is (786) 833-7645. The site footer and every service/area page show (786) 973-9973 — which is the GBP's chat/SMS number.
rows.fix: Global replace across the theme. Keep the SMS number only on a dedicated "Text us" button (sms: protocol).

rows.detail: The homepage and area pages return no JSON-LD LocalBusiness or Service schema. The richest site→GBP signal is missing entirely.
rows.fix: Add LocalBusiness schema sitewide with sameAs to the GBP Maps CID + the 6 social profiles. Service schema per booth-type page. FAQPage on /frequently-asked-questions.

rows.issue: URL structure — 27 location pages with random adjective slugs
rows.detail: 27 area pages use a different adjective per slug — fingerprint of programmatic-template content.
rows.fix: Consolidate to /photo-booth-rental/[city]/ with 301 redirects from old slugs.

rows.detail: Service axis (6 booth-type pages) and location axis (27 area pages) but no cell-level pages combining the two.
rows.fix: Build a 6×15 matrix (90 cell pages) over 90 days. Each ~400 words of unique copy.

rows.issue: Internal linking — area pages don't link to service pages, and blog pages don't link to commercial pages
rows.detail: Sampled three area pages: each links only to homepage and sibling area pages. Top blog post (photo-strip-size, 1,556 clicks/90d) doesn't link to /360-photo-booth or /glam-booth.
rows.fix: Add 3-paragraph "Booth types we bring to [city]" block on every area page + in-body CTAs on top blog posts pointing to booth-type service pages.

owner_asks.q: Top 5 revenue cities — can you confirm?
owner_asks.why: We're proposing the new /photo-booth-rental/[city]/ structure for 15 priority cities. We'd like the team's read on the 5 cities that drive the most actual bookings — so the first content sprint hits revenue-weighted, not just GBP-area-weighted.

owner_asks.q: Internal phone-routing on (786) 833-7645 — confirmed live and answered?
owner_asks.why: Before we push the global phone swap on the site and citations, we want to make sure the GBP primary number routes to a human and tracks the way the chat number does today.

owner_asks.q: Capacity for the 90-page matrix build — internal copywriter or HQDM?
owner_asks.why: We can write the 90 cells in-house or hand a template + city list to an internal writer. Confirming the path so we can sequence Month 1-3 accurately.

GA4 property 501143766 (HQDM Clients Local Campaign · MIA Photobooth) is confirmed accessible — but the existing OAuth token only has the GSC scope. Aleksandar to run python C:/Users/User/Desktop/HQDM/Secrets/gsc_auth.py to re-auth with analytics.readonly scope. Once done, the next pass adds Leads (form_submit + contact_form_submit), GMB clicks (gmb_click), phone clicks (click_phone_number) and email clicks (click_email) as separate trend lines — same attribution model we use for AQMS and Maison.
LD scans show MIA dropped from 67 top-3 cells in Aug to 2 in Sept, then recovered to 74 in Oct. Worth knowing if there was a GBP issue, category swap, or temporary suspension we should factor in.

owner_asks.q: "social photo booth rental miami" — 13,146 impressions at avg pos 4.1 with ZERO clicks (last 90d) — why?
owner_asks.why: This is the strongest single-query opportunity in GSC. Position 4.1 should produce some clicks. Likely candidates: (1) SERP is dominated by local pack + AI Overview, so the organic position-4 result never gets seen, or (2) the snippet is unappealing. We'll do a SERP audit in Week 2 of Month 1.
